scope: independent raw-source admission plus reported ledger arithmetic

source_admission.scope: independent source-only admission; no rhythm estimator executed
limitations: Source identity and symbolic annotations are independently parsed, not independently re-annotated.
Performance beat/downbeat annotations and the 4/4 quarter unit are supplied.
MIDI encoding tempo is not interpreted as the intended score tempo.
Key releases and controllers are preserved; no sounding duration or perceived naturalness is inferred.
Original XML note ties and grace positions are parsed directly; no rhythm estimator or scorer is imported.
Raw SMF/XML/CSV source identity and canonical maps were independently reconstructed; author annotations were not independently re-annotated.
All published masks, paired masks, denominators, gains/losses, strata and macro arithmetic were independently checked.
Per-hit estimator correctness and candidate-path truth primitives are independently reconstructed by the complementary model audit, not this arithmetic audit.
For wrong-versus-wrong paired decisions this audit sums the published same-wrong/disagreement mask; equality of chosen ticks requires the complementary model audit.
An executed-order receipt and frozen workflow are checked; this does not provide an external execution trace or human validation.
No audio, inferred acoustic clock, perceived naturalness, MIDI export roundtrip or product activation was evaluated.
